Non-birth parent chain: paid parental leave c3 5 days -> extended parental leave c4 52 (indemnity c5 to 60% for its first 11 weeks; QPIP paternity c8 5 from its start -> QPIP parental c9 32).

U8 path: the indemnities require confirmed eligibility for QPIP 'or for benefits from any other appropriate government agency'; the member described is resident in Quebec and under QPIP, which is coded. A member resident outside Quebec would receive EI or another province's benefits instead (Act s. 17.1); that path is not coded. A member not eligible for QPIP or other government benefits receives no University indemnity (2.12, 4.14).
Reduced load or part-time appointment (c6) substitutes the extended parental leave; pay pro-rated; no duration stated, so it adds no weeks and never wins R15b.

Version: the two APO pages are undated (footer 2017) and captured in April 2017 (academic year 2016-17, before the reference year 2017-18); components resting on the disability page carry version_uncertain. The APO maternity page only restates the Regulations. The Regulations were each approved before the reference date and listed on the Secretariat page in March 2018 (version notes).
Replacement funding for departments during maternity leave and STD (APO pages) is funding for the unit, not a benefit to the parent: not a component.

Leave-of-absence sections on secondment, political candidacy and public office (LOA Regulations ss. 8-10) cannot be used for a birth: not components. Compassionate-grounds grants (5.4.1) are part of the general leave of absence c17.

Documents cited but not saved: Regulations Relating to the Employment of Librarian Staff; Regulations Relating to the Employment of Contract Academic Staff; Regulations Relating to the Approval of Contracts and Signing Authority; University Statutes; 'Examples of the Range of Research Accomplishments, Recognition and Impacts Valued at McGill'; Maternity & Parental Leave Checklist (APO); QPIP website; APO pages 'Reappointing Tenure Track Academic Staff' and 'Tenure Consideration'; the STD and LTD plan documents themselves (not named by title).
No calendar: the documents define the academic year (1 September to 31 August) but no term length.
Employment Regulations Appendix B (research portfolio guidelines) is advisory and unrelated to leave.
